episodes.title: Episode 1324: Franni Cash, Plus the Carl Lentz Backlash and an All Hip-Hop One Has to Go
episodes.description: Former We The Kingdom singer Franni Cash grew up inside a cult, and her debut solo album 'Here I Am' is about what came after. We talk about the diary she had to hide, the day her family walked out, what she found when she met the real Jesus and what she'd tell anyone in a controlling church right now. The crew also gets into the backlash to Carl and Laura Lentz's latest round of interviews and what Christians actually expect from someone who is doing the work of repentance. In Slices, Derek takes us inside Peter Thiel's leaked lectures on the Antichrist, where the people the billionaire says to watch are not who you'd guess. Marty brings good news for anyone who has paid an AirBnB cleaning fee and had to do the dishes anyway. Then Marty's Life Hacks has a listener-submitted tip about your chips that the rest of us are still processing, and Derek gets some constructive feedback on the zipper location in his new music video. An all hip-hop One Has to Go closes it out, and with two rappers on the panel, somebody was always going to get flamed.
